metadata.title: fix(rbac): respect PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX setting in personal team slug generation
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Fix `before_insert` listener on `EmailTeam` that unconditionally overwrote slugs, making `PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX` config setting have no effect
- Add `if not target.slug` guard so explicitly-set slugs survive insertion
- Change default prefix from `"personal"` to `""` (zero behavior change for existing deployments)
- Update `create_personal_team()` to use config prefix when set, producing collision-safe email-derived slugs

Closes #3494

commits.message:
fix(rbac): respect PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX setting in personal team slug generation

The `before_insert` listener on `EmailTeam` unconditionally overwrote
the slug with `slugify(name)`, discarding the prefix-based slug set by
`create_personal_team()`. This made the `PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX` config
setting have no runtime effect and caused slug collisions for users
with the same display name.

- Add `if not target.slug` guard to `set_email_team_slug` listener so
  explicitly-set slugs survive insertion
- Change default `personal_team_prefix` from `"personal"` to `""` for
  zero behavior change on existing deployments
- Update `create_personal_team()` to use the config prefix when set,
  producing collision-safe email-derived slugs (e.g.
  `personal-alice-example-com`), and fall back to `slugify(team_name)`
  when empty
- Update config schema, Helm values, and docs to reflect new default

Closes #3494

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(rbac): normalize PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX before use in slug generation

Slugify and strip the configured prefix to prevent whitespace-only or
special-character prefixes from producing invalid slugs that bypass URL
expectations.

Closes #3494

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(rbac): address codex review findings for PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX fix

- Remove "collision-safe" claim from changelog (email transform is lossy)
- Add edge-case tests for prefix normalization (whitespace, punctuation,
  mixed special characters)
- Clarify .env.example comment that prefix is optional

Closes #3494
